items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: And we sent and got a fellow out of Andy Kirk's band, named Big Jim

ctx.x: That's right. The -- the band that Kirk joined the Noble Sissle band, opened at Billy Rose's Diamond Horseshoe in New York and they played there several years, didn't they? They played there four or five years.
Then they kept him as the house drummer.
